params.linkText: priced a two-part private debt placement

children: The offering is split into two senior unsecured note tranches: C$200M in 4.00% notes due September 25, 2028, priced at 99.935%. C$350M in 4.40% notes due September 25, 2030, priced at 99.989%.
The transaction is slated to close on September 25, 2026.
The senior unsecured notes will pay interest semi-annually on March 25 and September 25, with first payments beginning March 25, 2027.

CNH Industrial Capital Canada plans to direct the net proceeds into its general funds to support day-to-day operations, working capital requirements, routine asset and receivable purchases, and upcoming debt repayments.
Full backing is provided via guarantees from CNH Industrial Capital LLC, CNH Industrial Capital America LLC, and New Holland Credit Company LLC, all indirect subsidiaries of CNH Industrial N.V.
